parameters.query:
-- Mark any run that never finished as failed, then open a new run.
-- The window starts at the last successful run (minus a day for safety), or 14 days back on the first run.
WITH stale AS (
  UPDATE runs SET status = 'failed', finished_at = now(), error = 'Run did not finish'
  WHERE status = 'running'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO runs (fetched_from)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(finished_at) - interval '1 day', now() - interval '14 days')
FROM runs WHERE status = 'succeeded'
RETURNING id AS run_id, fetched_from;

-- Insert each notice once. The same notice with the same content is skipped;
-- an amended notice (new content) gets a new row. Then close the run with its counts.
WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS t(
    source_id text, title text, buyer text, country text, cpv_codes text[],
    deadline timestamptz, url text, raw jsonb)
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO tenders (source, source_id, content_hash, title, buyer, country, cpv_codes, deadline, url, raw)
  SELECT 'ted', source_id, md5(raw::text), title, buyer, country, cpv_codes, deadline, url, raw
  FROM input
  ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT tenders_idempotency DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE runs
SET status = 'succeeded', finished_at = now(), fetched = $3::int, inserted = (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)
WHERE id = $2::bigint
RETURNING id AS run_id, fetched, inserted;
